intent: Extract only the defined fields using exact source text. Preserve source formatting. Use null for absent or ambiguous scalar values; do not arbitrarily choose among multiple values. For repeated columns preserve each complete source row relation and exact supporting quotes.

fields.description: Date explicitly identified as filing or receipt of the registration. Do not substitute a signature date unless it is also explicitly the filing date.
Name of the foreign principal represented by the registrant; this field ID preserves the published task spelling. Do not substitute the registered agent or signer.
Name of the registered organization or person identified as registrant. Do not substitute the foreign principal, signatory or preparer.
Registration identifier assigned to the registrant, preserving letters and leading zeros; not an exhibit, page or filing number.
Name of the person who signs the registration or declaration, when explicitly readable in source text.
Stated position or title of the signatory who signs the registration or declaration.
